name: Surtsey
description: Surtsey is a young volcanic island about 32 km off Iceland's south coast, born when an undersea eruption broke the surface in November 1963 and kept going until 1967. Off-limits to visitors and left untouched, it has let scientists watch life arrive from scratch, from the first seeds on ocean currents to 60 plant species, hundreds of insects and dozens of nesting seabirds.
